title: Validate image content before sending to Computer Vision
summary: Image Analysis Management now validates image content before sending to Computer Vision endpoints, rejecting non-image blobs and unsupported formats while supporting JPEG, PNG, GIF and BMP.
key_points: Validates that uploaded content is a supported image format before HTTP request
Accepts JPEG, PNG, GIF and BMP formats matching documented Computer Vision and Custom Vision requirements
Loads and decodes image files using System Application Image codeunit
Rejects non-image content and unsupported formats through existing error notification path
No universal size limits or minimum dimensions imposed; API-specific checks remain with configured service
quote: Validate image content before sending it to the configured Vision endpoint.
